secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Project Settings > API > Project URL). Used for auth and all data via the Supabase REST API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key. SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is read as a fallback.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role/secret key. SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is read as a fallback.

secrets.name: PADDLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Paddle API key for billing checkout/subscriptions.

secrets.name: PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Paddle webhook signing secret for /api/billing/webhook.
